    nvptx-run: error getting kernel result: an illegal memory access was encountered (CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS, 700)

I have to have a look what's going on.  (For now, let's assume it's specific to nvptx target.)  I can get '-O2', '-Os' back to PASS with '-fno-optimize-crc', thus "[15 Regression]".

However, a different observation: with plain '-O3' (without '-fno-optimize-crc'), there are earlier code transformations (to be determined) that apparently preclude CRC optimization.  I can't tell if that's profitable or not.
